title: The Red Thread of Fate Leads to Revolutionary Souvenirs ~ Rainbow Ornament
description:
Or, if you prefer:
「運命の赤い糸は革命の記念に至る　～ Rainbow Ornament」

A Touhou-style composition, perhaps an Extra boss theme or something of the sort, that won 1st place in Super Famicompo 6's Originals category.

It's got calmer sections, chaotic sections, and lots of SMW sample goodness.

Can you figure out what the title represents?
